Inclusive & Collaborative

Draw on your skills and develop new ones as part of a PEAK pod. We work in small groups to take on meaty challenges, support each other, celebrate shared successes, and remain connected.

Open Roles

PEAK Technology Partners is a boutique investment bank that provides strategic and financial advice to high-growth technology companies. The firm partners with technology leaders seeking to execute M&A and capital raise transactions. To apply, send a cover letter and resume to recruiting@peak-tech.com.

PEAK offers securities through Finalis Securities LLC; Office of Supervisory Jurisdiction is located at 450 Lexington Ave, New York, NY 10017, 800-962-0418.
 

Investment Banking Analyst

An analyst’s responsibilities at PEAK go above and beyond deal execution and encompass a focus on business development, including deal sourcing, outbound prospecting, and maintaining relationships with prospective clients. Learn more about the role.
